method.re_derivation: Every scored body was re-parsed with si.gaia.proposer.parse_proposal at main cf3a5f4, invoked exactly as the C-1 harness invoked it for SI-100 (journal=None, task_seq=item parse_task_seq — absent in this corpus, so None). Stage outcomes here are re-derived, not copied.
method.control: The SI-100 harness record (~/workspace/si-dev-loop/si100-scoring-record.json results.items) is the control: stage_reached, failing_stage, failing_stage_name, parse_ok and response_hash were compared per item.
method.fold_facts: Read from the SI-100 capture bundle (~/workspace/si100-work/capture/capture-bundle, opened on a copy): journal tip 43; checkpoints rows at seqs 1 and 4; experience rows at seqs 5-43 — task rows at seqs 5, 13, 24, 31 (four tasks serve the six workloads; each item's prompt_ref.task_seq names its task) and hearth_residency rows at the remaining seqs; the fold contains NO tool-intent rows (capture admits and executes nothing), so no seq-form depends_on entry in this cycle-0 corpus could name an already-journaled tool intent of its task under §9.3 — the taxonomy classifies the FORM of each cited reference against that fold. Sibling entries are priced document-locally by the parser and are never fold-checked (SI-97 §5.2).
method.citation: Bodies live once in the frozen SI-100 corpus file; every item is cited by response hash + corpus item id. No body text is copied into this record except sub-50-char stage-1 fragments quoted as classification evidence.
method.attribution_discipline: Form-presence counts for SI-94 are computed over its 30 scored bodies (docs/SI-94-corpus.json) with the same body audit. One capture run per configuration, n=30 scored bodies each, same candidate and serving: presence/absence is descriptive of the two frozen corpora only. Absence in 30 bodies does not prove a form impossible under a configuration, and presence does not prove the configuration caused it; sampling variance cannot be excluded for any single form. No causal claim is made anywhere in this record.

stage_3_defect_aggregates.shadowed: no stage-3 defect is shadowed anywhere in the corpus: bodies failing stages 1/2 carry no registry violations, and bodies reaching stage 3 fail on their first defective intent (the parser prices one intent's violations at a time; all 9 defective intents are intents[0] of their bodies)

sibling_audit.reading: the only two sibling entries in the 30 scored bodies are both {sibling: 0} self-references at intent position 0, and both are shadowed behind stage-3 failures — the parser never priced them.
